description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The value can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length.
The ID of the service instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier deploy-service-instance --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --service-instance-id si-0e6fca6a51a544200000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
